caseNameFull: State Tax Commission of Utah v. Untermyer, Executors
attorneys: Messrs. Grover A. Giles, Attorney General of Utah, and J. Lambert Gibson for petitioners. Mr. Eugene Untermyer for respondents.

opinions.text:
On petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Utah.

Per Curiam:

The petition for writ of certiorari is granted and the judgment is reversed on authority of State Tax Commission of Utah v. Aldrich, ante, p. 174.
